story.title: The dodo bird had a secret sensory world scientists are only now discovering
story.reason: Overturns old misconceptions about the dodo, revealing a clever and sensory-rich creature that charms the imagination.
story.title_ja: ドードー鳥の知られざる感覚の世界：旧来のイメージを覆す発見
story.reason_ja: おっとりしたイメージだったドードー鳥が、実は豊かな感覚を持つ賢い鳥だったことが分かり、昔の誤解を解く微笑ましいニュースです。
story.jp_copy: これまでのイメージとは異なり、絶滅したドードー鳥が実は豊かな感覚世界と知性を持っていたことが最新の研究で判明しました。長年の誤解が解け、ドードー鳥の賢く魅力的な素顔が明らかになる、知的好奇心に満ちた嬉しい発見です。
story.en_copy: Long misunderstood, the dodo bird is now being revealed as a clever creature with a rich sensory world. Scientists are overturning old misconceptions, giving us a fresh and charming perspective on a smart bird whose true nature is finally being appreciated.
story.duck_jp: ドードー鳥は実はとっても賢かったんですね！誤解が解けて良かった！
story.duck_en: The dodo was clever all along! Glad history is setting the record straight.
story.x_jp: 鈍感だと思われていたドードー鳥の秘密が解明！実は豊かな感覚と知性を持った賢い鳥だったことが分かりました。
story.x_en: New discoveries show the dodo bird was actually clever and sensory-rich, overturning old misconceptions!

concepts.title_ja: 現代の研究室とドードーの輝くホログラム
concepts.concept_ja: 現代的な研究ラボで、デイリーダックがドードーの脳や感覚器を表す光る3Dディスプレイを観察し、その高い知性と感覚機能の発見に驚き喜ぶカット。
concepts.concept_en: In a modern science lab, the Daily Duck enthusiastically examines a glowing 3D holographic model of a dodo bird, highlighting its hidden intelligence and sensory capacity.
concepts.composition_ja: 明るくクリーンな研究室。左側に丸眼鏡をかけたイエローのデイリーダック、中央に浮かぶドードーの透き通るような美しい発光ホログラム。背景はすっきりとした実験室のデスク。
concepts.composition_en: Bright modern lab background. On the left, the iconic yellow Daily Duck wearing tiny round glasses looks admiringly at a crystal-clear glowing 3D dodo hologram floating above a sleek desk in the center. Clean, high-tech editorial layout.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial 3D illustration for news story. The iconic Daily Duck mascot—a friendly yellow duckling with an orange beak, large dark glossy eyes, a tiny feather tuft on top, and an eager expression—wearing small round researcher glasses. The duck stands at a clean white laboratory desk, gazing in wonder at a vibrant glowing blue and golden holographic 3D model of a sleek dodo bird floating above the table. Clean modern laboratory backdrop with soft ambient lighting, high contrast, clean studio background, no text, no logos, no watermarks, cinematic composition, 8k render.
concepts.alt_ja: 研究室でドードーの光る3Dホログラムモデルを感銘を受けて見つめる、丸眼鏡をかけたデイリーダック。
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck wearing small glasses, looking in wonder at a glowing blue holographic model of a dodo bird in a modern research lab.

concepts.title_ja: 豊かな自然の中で手を取り合うダックとドードー
concepts.concept_ja: ドードーが生息していた美しい熱帯の森で、デイリーダックとドードー鳥が仲良く並び、空間を満たすカラフルな感覚の光の波線や植物の香りの粒子を楽しんでいるネイチャーシーン。
concepts.concept_en: Set in the dodo's natural tropical paradise, the Daily Duck walks side-by-side with a friendly dodo bird, surrounded by glowing ribbons of light and scent particles that represent its vibrant sensory world.
concepts.composition_ja: 黄金色の木漏れ日が差し込む美しい森。中央にデイリーダックと可愛らしいスタイライズされたドードー鳥。周囲にふわふわと浮かぶ光の粒子や優美な感覚のオーラ。
concepts.composition_en: Wide shot of a lush tropical forest with soft golden sunlight filtering through canopy leaves. In the center, the iconic yellow Daily Duck stands side-by-side with a friendly, charmingly rendered dodo bird. Soft colorful glowing trails and delicate scent particles float gently in the air around them.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Modern editorial style 3D illustration. A lush, vibrant tropical island forest with soft golden sunlight streaming through palm leaves. In the center, the recognizable Daily Duck—a bright yellow friendly duck with an orange beak, glossy dark eyes, and a cute feather tuft—walks happily next to a friendly, intelligent-looking stylized dodo bird with soft gray feathers. Floating around them are sparkling, soft pastel light ribbons and delicate glowing particles representing sensory perception. Warm, inviting atmosphere, clean aesthetic, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 木漏れ日が差し込む美しい熱帯の森で、光る感覚の粒子に包まれながらドードー鳥と並んで歩くデイリーダック。
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck walking alongside a friendly dodo bird in a sunlit tropical forest surrounded by glowing floating sensory particles.

concepts.title_ja: 歴史の1ページをめくる発見
concepts.concept_ja: 「鈍感なドードー」という古いスケッチが描かれた大きな古書のページをデイリーダックがめくると、下から鮮やかで知的な新しいドードーの姿が現れる象徴的な構図。
concepts.concept_en: A symbolic storytelling visual where the Daily Duck lifts an old book page showing a dim monochrome dodo to reveal a brightly glowing, colorful illustration of a clever dodo bird underneath.
concepts.composition_ja: 真上からのバードアイ構図。大きな開かれた本。左側にはモノクロの古いドードーのスケッチ、右側（めくられた部分）には彩り豊かな賢いドードーのイラスト。デイリーダックが誇らしげにページをめくっている。
concepts.composition_en: High-angle overhead shot of a large antique book lying open on a clean wooden desk. The Daily Duck is lifting a dusty old page displaying a dull, monochrome dodo sketch to reveal underneath a brightly glowing, vibrant color illustration of a smart, energetic dodo bird.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Studio editorial photographic illustration. Top-down overhead composition looking down at a large open book on a warm minimal studio table. The Daily Duck—a small yellow duckling with an orange beak, glossy black eyes, and a charming feather tuft—is standing beside the book, proudly lifting the top edge of a faded page. The old faded page shows a monochrome classic dodo illustration, while underneath reveals a brilliantly colorful, modern illuminated depiction of a sharp, clever dodo bird radiating warm golden light rays. Crisp lighting, clean layout, storytelling art, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 古いドードーのスケッチが描かれたページをめくり、下に隠された鮮やかな新しいドードーの絵を披露するデイリーダック。
concepts.alt_en: High-angle view of the Daily Duck turning an old book page to reveal a bright, vibrant artwork of a clever dodo bird beneath it.

concepts.title_ja: 感覚のシンフォニーと音楽的アプローチ

concepts.concept_en: A cheerful, artistic interpretation comparing sensory depth to music. The Daily Duck and a friendly dodo bird wear modern headphones together, immersed in a wave of visual sound notes and sensory color swirls.
concepts.composition_ja: パステル調のシンプルな背景。中央に色違いのヘッドホンをつけたデイリーダックとドードー鳥。周りには音符、香りの波、光のグラデーションがポップに弾けている。
concepts.composition_en: Minimalist pastel editorial setting. In the center, the yellow Daily Duck and a cute, expressive dodo bird are both wearing colorful oversized headphones, closing their eyes in delight as vibrant stylized wave rings, notes, and sensory glow swirl gently around them.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Modern minimalist studio visual artwork. On a clean soft pastel gradient background, the iconic yellow Daily Duck mascot—with its plump yellow body, orange beak, big shiny eyes, and top feather tuft—sits happily beside a charming dodo bird. Both the duck and the dodo are wearing stylish modern bright teal headphones. Swirling around them are elegant 3D geometric sound waves, colorful pastel scent trails, and glowing sparkle icons that represent a rich sensory world. Fun, joyful, clean editorial design, high-end 3D render, studio lighting, no text, no watermarks, no logos.
concepts.alt_ja: ヘッドホンを装着し、周りに広がるカラフルな感覚の波線や光をドードーと一緒に満喫するデイリーダック。
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck and a friendly dodo wearing modern headphones, surrounded by colorful floating sensory wave patterns and light glows.

concepts.title_ja: 拡大鏡で覗く脳と感覚の秘密
concepts.concept_ja: デイリーダックが大きな虫眼鏡をかざして、ドードー鳥の精巧なフィギュアや感覚神経モデルを調査し、新発見に目を輝かせる探偵・研究者風のデスク構図。
concepts.concept_en: The Daily Duck acts as a curious investigator, looking through a large magnifying glass at a detailed dodo model whose inner sensory pathways glow with sparkling fiber-optic light.
concepts.composition_ja: デスク上でのローアングル・クローズアップ。探偵帽をかぶったデイリーダックが虫眼鏡を掲げ、レンズの先に美しく光るドードーのモデルを覗き込んでいる。
concepts.composition_en: Dynamic close-up view at desk level. The Daily Duck, wearing a cute detective hat, holds up a magnifying glass toward a small, detailed dodo figurine on a desk. Through the glass, the sensory regions of the dodo glow with intricate rainbow fiber-optic light.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Dynamic macro visual editorial photo. Close-up composition at desk level. The yellow Daily Duck mascot—featuring a friendly soft expression, round body, orange bill, big shiny black eyes, and small feather tuft—wears a tiny classic brown detective cap. The duck holds a magnifying glass aimed at a small sculpted dodo figurine on a warm wooden desk. Illuminated through the magnifying lens, bright intricate colorful fiber-optic lights detail the dodo's sensory neural pathways in a magical way. Depth of field with soft background blur, warm cinematic lighting, highly detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

concepts.alt_en: Close-up of the Daily Duck in a detective cap looking through a magnifying glass at a dodo figurine with glowing sensory light pathways.
